Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

This petition has been filed praying the following main reliefs:-

crime no. 425 of 2023 under section 406/419/420 467/468/471/ 504 I.P.C registered at Police station Zaidpur Distt Barabanki on 7.10.2023 lodged by the opposite party no.4 as contained in annexure no. 1 to this writ petition.
